clue_weather_vial.title: Vial of Captured Petrichor
clue_weather_vial.description: A glass vial containing compressed monsoon scent that swirls with tiny lightning arcs.
clue_weather_vial.lore: When uncorked, causes parchment to reveal hidden elevation contours.

clue_monsoon_compass.title: Barometric Compass
clue_monsoon_compass.description: Points not toward north, but toward areas of highest atmospheric depression.
clue_monsoon_compass.lore: Guided ancient navigators to the hidden Cloud Archipelago.
